Bill.BriefDescription: Helping ensure that eligible renewable resources creating thermal energy are eligible for renewable energy credits as defined in RCW 19.285.030.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to helping ensure that eligible renewable resourcescreating thermal energy are eligible for renewable energy credits asdefined in RCW 19.285.030; and adding a new section to chapter 19.285RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.285 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that thermal energy resources are animportant part of the state's energy strategy, and that renewablethermal energy is a useful alternative to fossil-fueled thermal energy. (2) Eligible renewable energy resources do not have to be convertedto electricity for purposes of receiving renewable energy credits. Therules must specify the quantity of energy derived from an eligiblerenewable energy resource that is equal to one megawatt hour ofelectricity, including that one megawatt hour equals 3,412,142 Britishthermal units. (3) Renewable energy credits that have been converted from British p. 1 HB 2556thermal units into electricity units may not be used to meet renewableenergy targets set forth under RCW 19.285.040.
